name: s0_both_clampsafe
description: Clamp-safe reissue of s0_both. Identical in every field except the two distance coefficients, which are scaled down (reward_dist_ball 0.02 -> 0.015, reward_dist_endzone 0.04 -> 0.025) so the worst-case single-step PBRS terminal payback stays inside PPO's [-1,1] clamp. s0_both's coefficients put the maximum potential payback at 0.96 on the same agent-step as the TD/win objective stack, and the clamp truncated only that one-shot repayment while the tiny +Phi increments earned on the way up never clipped -- so the telescoping guarantee of D226 was broken in the agent's favour on exactly the behaviour being taught. Scaling the coefficients keeps the shaping EXACT PBRS (reward_dist_pbrs_gamma stays 0.995) rather than weakening the guarantee by spreading the payback or widening the clamp, either of which would change every historical comparison.
